cache_url_download: cache a remote URL resource locally with file locking to avoid duplicate downloads
save_file_serialize: save data to .pkl, .npy, .json, or .yaml files with append or overwrite options
load_file_deserialize: load data from .pkl, .npy, .json, .yaml, .csv, or .txt files with mmap support for numpy
copy_data_transfer: copy a file or directory to a destination using rsync with optional slurm directory routing
copy_data_to_local_batch: iteratively copy a list of files or directories to a local destination directory
